gap3.closed_statement: For every declared finite GHD regulator, the linear fluctuating theory is an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process with exact covariance Sigma(t)=C+exp(Lt)[Sigma(0)-C]exp(L^dagger t).
gap3.not_claimed: uniform convergence of the h->0 infinite-mode limit

gap4.closed_statement: Schur elimination of every retained non-spin mode gives the exact frequency-dependent scalar Mori resolvent.  The exact mu26 prefix gives thirteen positive recurrents but does not choose a unique positive terminator.

gap5.closed_statement: Global pi spin rotation makes the physical current odd in the magnetic source, so the zero-field quadratic Kubo vertex vanishes.  A one-sided, orientation-conditioned wall coordinate is a different observable and may be nonzero.
gap5.not_claimed: universality of the conditional finite-window coordinate

gap7.closed_statement: The orientation-odd tangent of a sharp product wall is a linear combination of spin-density Fourier modes.  With those modes in the Mori projector, its linear initial slip is exactly zero.
gap7.not_claimed: a bound on the unknown O(mu^6) coefficient or a sharp-wall pointwise local-GGE expansion

interpretation: Closure means the stated algebraic theorem is complete.  It does not silently promote a finite regulator, a conditional wall coordinate, or a finite moment prefix to a unique asymptotic constant-coefficient Burgers equation.
